---
title: "Architecture"
---

## Request Path

```text
Quarto source -> app/_site static client
                    |
                    | POST /api/v1/analyze
                    v
              FastAPI + Pydantic
                    |
                    v
            shared analyze() function
                    |
                    v
             Hamilton + Polars
```

The browser initiates every interaction. The initial architecture has no server-push channel. FastAPI mounts the rendered client for same-origin operation after `quarto render app`.

## Documentation Boundary

`app/` is the product interface. `docs/` is the Divio project documentation site. Sharing Quarto as a renderer does not make them the same Managed Surface.

## Ownership

The generated scaffold becomes downstream-owned. Existing applications may attach Metadata v2 Managed Surfaces explicitly, promote one eligible surface, or use all-or-nothing broad promotion after every target surface conforms.
